officeHours.notes: Parish office transactions, certificate releasing, and booking verifications are entertained strictly during regular office hours.

massSchedule.notes: There is no 9:00 AM Sunday Mass. Nearest morning slots are 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Schedules are subject to liturgical feast updates.

confessionSchedule.location: Confessional Area near the Sacred Heart Shrine
confessionSchedule.sickCalls: Available anytime by emergency appointment through the Parish Office (0997 742 8176).

keywords: how much is a house blessing
houseAndVehicleBlessing.feePolicy: No mandatory fixed fee. The parish welcomes any voluntary offering or free-will donation (love offering) for the officiating priest and parish ministry.
houseAndVehicleBlessing.leadTime: Please request at least 1 week in advance for priest availability.
requirements: Complete physical address and landmarks (for house) or vehicle model and plate number
Preferred date and time
Contact person name and active mobile number
houseAndVehicleBlessing.whereToRequest: Submit online via Request Blessing (users/request-blessing.php) or coordinate with the Parish Office.

wedding.leadTime: Apply at least 2 to 3 months prior to target wedding date.
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of Groom and Bride
PSA CENOMAR (valid within 6 months)
Updated Baptismal & Confirmation Certificates annotated 'For Marriage Purposes'
Pre-Cana Marriage Seminar Certificate
Canonical Interview with Parish Priest
Publication of Marriage Banns for 3 consecutive Sundays
Local Civil Registrar Marriage License (or Article 34 Affidavit)
